name: Maestro: Attack on Titan
summary:
Take command of a massive orchestra as the walls tremble and humanity’s fate hangs in the balance!

Lead your orchestra through two iconic masterpieces from japanese animation masterpiece Attack on Titan.
From its haunting melodies to its most raging moments, feel the tension rise and unleash the full force of the orchestra as you conduct two epic anthems that have become legendary among anime fans!

Your Attack on Titan music pieces:

• Kohta Yamamoto – “Attack on Titan” (from Attack on Titan)
• Hiroyuki Sawano – “Ashes on The Fire” (from Attack on Titan)

Raise your Titan Sweeper, the exclusive conductor baton included with this DLC, and bring the world of Attack on Titan to life!
